defects.title: The hierarchical method returns the requested maximum k as the number of clusters
defects.observed: clusters = [1 2 3 4], k = 20, eco.k = 20 (line 173: k = kMax); getEcosystemClusterReactionValues then returns 20 columns, 16 NaN, and changing=true counts those NaN as changes
defects.expected: k = eco.k = 4, the number of clusters formed (OUTPUTS: 'k: number of clusters'), as the dbscan branch computes

notes: Reproduction: eco = struct('qualVectors', [1 0 0; 1 0 0; 0 3 0; 0 3 1]); [e, c, k] = clusterEcosystemPoints(eco, 'printLevel', 0) -> c = [1 2 3 4]', k = 20. Also with kMax < n when tied merge heights leave fewer than kMax clusters (fcluster 'maxclust' semantics). Decision for the lead: the Python original (Ecosystem.clusterPoints) may also store the requested k (not checked: its source is not in the repository), in which case this is faithful-to-Python behaviour (Principle VIII); if the lead rules it intended (doc fix only), reclassify as cosmetic and a full test can be written (testEcosystemClustering.m already checks clusters against SciPy). No src caller of clusterEcosystemPoints exists (tests/tutorials only). Existing test testEcosystemClustering.m (no 'Function under test' header) asserts k == 3 only where kMax equals the cluster count.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: hierarchical branch returns k = kMax, line 173; OUTPUTS document k as the number of clusters)

defects.title: Zero band applied inconsistently to the maximum and to max - min
defects.observed: [5 2 -2] ({'err','++','--'}) for delta = 0; [5 2] for delta = 1e-9: state -1 needs max < delta (line 75) and the fixed states -3/3 need |max-min| < delta (lines 68, 85)
defects.expected: [-1 3 -3] ({'-0','+','-'}) and [-1 3]: the documented table treats |x| <= delta (and max - min within delta) as zero; delta = 0 is allowed (non-negative scalar)

notes: Reproduction: getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2], [0 2 -2], 0) -> [5 2 -2]; getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2], [1e-9, 2+1e-9], 1e-9) -> [5 2]; getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2], [0 2], 1e-9) -> [-1 3] (inside the band it is right). Callers to quarantine: ecosystemQualitativeFVA (passes the user's delta; line 149) and whatever reaches it. The defect needs delta = 0 or a value exactly at the band edge; with the default 1e-9 and ordinary FVA values it is rare, so the lead may judge the quarantine of callers too broad.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: the -1 rule uses mx < delta, line 75, the zero rule mx <= delta; with delta = 0 a value at the threshold gets state 5 and a fixed flux never gets 3, lines 68 and 85)
